memberships.page_title: The Categorical Quotient of Bounded Cubic Frames

statement: At a simple escape wall the graph closure is the blowup of the corresponding weighted ideal, and for an escape of length m the principal-part coordinates give a finite-type projective separated weighted degeneration space with weights (1,...,m,m+1,m,...,2).
title: Weighted Graph Closures Give Separated Spaces of Cubic-Frame Degenerations
